whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Power Zone,

I noticed your gym has outstanding 4.9★ reviews with 200+ members in Biscomaun Colony, Patna, and already has a clean online presence via your Lovable demo app.

Maine aapke fitness club ke liye ek high-conversion custom website architecture design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, dynamic membership tiers (Silver, Gold, Diamond), aur BMI calculator integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://strength-zone-genesis.lovable.app/

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Power Zone Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke fitness club ke liye ek custom website architecture aur mobile booking concept review karke WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, membership pricing tiers, and mobile-first speed for your members in Biscomaun Colony, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact branding aur membership features integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
